prompt: A horizontal banner image with a light beige background. On the left side, there is Japanese text in purple and yellow: '制作記録 #2 敵キャラ編' (Production Record #2 Enemy Character Edition), followed by large bold text '生成AIの「あるある」がモンスターに！' (Generative AI's "Common Occurrences" become monsters!), and smaller text below 'ジェネコの冒険 ～ノイズの大迷宮～ 敵キャラ制作の2日間' (Geneko's Adventure ~ The Labyrinth of Noise ~ Two Days of Enemy Character Creation). To the right of the text, there are two small chibi characters: a girl with brown hair wearing glasses and a school uniform holding an open book, and a blue cat-like creature with pink ears reading over her shoulder. The rest of the image is filled with a collage of various colorful monster designs arranged in rows. Top row includes a shiny green sphere with eyes, a muscular blue furry beast with glowing purple eyes, a purple insectoid robot with green wings, and a multi-limbed robotic figure. Middle section features a red beetle-like creature with warning signs on its shell, a wizard character wearing a rainbow-colored pointed hat and robe holding a staff, a white moth-like creature with blue eye patterns on its wings, a black spider-tank hybrid with red lights, and a pink abstract shape resembling a face or symbol. Bottom row shows a green goblin-like creature with glowing yellow eyes, a brown spiky turtle-like monster, a pale humanoid figure with blank facial features, a split-faced doll character (half pink/half grey) holding a knife, and a purple blob monster with angry eyes.
